scenario.description: A pediatric emergency department medical director must decide whether to activate an unused observation wing for a forecasted respiratory-illness surge and finalize the space, staffing, oxygen, and inpatient-transfer plan, with input from pediatric emergency medicine, facilities, nursing staffing, and bed management.

shared_context.S1: The pediatric emergency department is operating near its usual capacity, with 10 of 12 treatment spaces occupied.
shared_context.S2: An unused observation wing with eight bays is available for temporary clinical use tomorrow.
shared_context.S3: The hospital is monitoring a regional increase in pediatric respiratory illness and expects emergency-department demand to be higher tomorrow.
shared_context.S4: Dr. Morgan has authority to activate the observation wing and set the operating plan for it.
shared_context.S5: The department's standing surge huddle is held before the operating plan is finalized, and it includes pediatric emergency medicine, facilities, nursing staffing, and bed management.
shared_context.S6: The surge plan requires all patients expected to need monitored observation during the 07:00 to 13:00 surge window to be accommodated simultaneously in the observation wing; the main emergency department cannot hold monitored-observation overflow during that window.
shared_context.S7: Under the approved surge policy, the six forecasted monitored-observation patients must all have observation-wing places during the 07:00 to 13:00 window; activating fewer than six bays is not a permitted operating plan, and the demanding staffing ratio is accepted for this surge standard.

PF1.text: The pediatric emergency physician's regional call forecast projects eight additional pediatric arrivals between 07:00 and 13:00 tomorrow, and six of them are likely to need monitored observation rather than rapid discharge.

PF2.text: Facilities inspected the observation wing this afternoon and confirmed that only bays Obs-2 through Obs-7 have functioning wall oxygen outlets; the two portable oxygen units are already committed elsewhere tomorrow.

PF3.text: The staffing roster confirms that exactly two pediatric RNs and one respiratory therapist can cover the observation wing from 07:00 through 19:00 tomorrow; no additional pediatric RN or respiratory therapist can be assigned during that interval. The organization has accepted this staffing level as the operating standard for the six-bay surge plan.

PF4.text: Bed management has confirmed four pediatric inpatient beds will be released by 15:00 tomorrow, so four observation-wing patients can be transferred by that time if the receiving beds are reserved in advance.

acceptance_conditions: The observation wing must be activated for tomorrow.
Exactly six observation bays must be opened.
The opened bays must be Obs-2 through Obs-7.
The staffing plan must provide two pediatric RNs and one respiratory therapist from 07:00 through 19:00 tomorrow.
The oxygen plan must use the functioning wall outlets in Obs-2 through Obs-7 rather than portable oxygen units.
Four inpatient beds must be reserved for transfers by 15:00 tomorrow.
The projected eight additional arrivals and six monitored-observation needs must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C3: ('Obs-2 through Obs-7' in decisions['surge_bays']) or ('Obs-2, Obs-3, Obs-4, Obs-5, Obs-6, Obs-7' in decisions['surge_bays'])
content_checks.C4: (('two pediatric RNs' in decisions['staffing_plan'] or 'Two pediatric RNs' in decisions['staffing_plan'] or 'two RNs' in decisions['staffing_plan'] or 'Two RNs' in decisions['staffing_plan']) and ('one respiratory therapist' in decisions['staffing_plan'] or 'One respiratory therapist' in decisions['staffing_plan'] or 'one RT' in decisions['staffing_plan'] or 'One RT' in decisions['staffing_plan']) and (('07:00 through 19:00' in decisions['staffing_plan']) or ('07:00-19:00' in decisions['staffing_plan']) or ('07:00–19:00' in decisions['staffing_plan'])))
content_checks.C5: (('Obs-2 through Obs-7' in decisions['oxygen_plan'] or 'Obs-2-Obs-7' in decisions['oxygen_plan'] or 'Obs-2 to Obs-7' in decisions['oxygen_plan']) and ('wall oxygen' in decisions['oxygen_plan'] or 'functioning oxygen' in decisions['oxygen_plan']))
content_checks.C7: any(((('bed_reservation' in c['type']) or ('bed reservation' in c['type']) or ('bed_management' in c['type']) or ('bed management' in c['type']) or ('inpatient_bed_reservation' in c['type']) or ('inpatient bed reservation' in c['type'])) and (('four' in c['detail']) or ('4' in c['detail'])) and '15:00' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The forecast changes the plan from no activation or a smaller activation to activating six bays because exactly six monitored-observation patients must be accommodated simultaneously during the surge window.
The facilities inspection changes the usable bay assignment to exactly Obs-2 through Obs-7 and changes the oxygen plan to those bays' functioning wall oxygen outlets.
The staffing roster fixes the operating plan at exactly two pediatric RNs and one respiratory therapist from 07:00 through 19:00, rather than allowing a generic staffing plan.
The bed release confirmation changes the transfer plan to exactly four inpatient beds by 15:00 and makes an advance four-bed reservation necessary.
